I find that all the staff are fantastic, from the receptionists to the doctors. Laura Nymark on reception especially has a lovely manner and is welcoming, making people of all backgrounds feel safe and welcome at the surgery! She is very relatable and exemplary, a true role model for others, and definitely displays the attributes I think of when I consider what makes me proud of the NHS!

I also had a great experience with Nurse Nerali Patel, who took her time to explain the procedure and to make sure I was fully comfortable and informed, as well as giving advice on what she recommends for next time. It felt like she had unlimited time for me, and I was treated with patience and dignity.
